snippet.title: Spider Tanks: Cores of Chaos Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Spider Tanks: Cores of Chaos is a Multiplayer PvP Brawler for PC, Mac, iOS and Android (cross-platform) in which Players customize their Tank from a wide variety of Parts in the garage, then battle it out in high octane 3v3 mayhem. Assemble your tank, annihilate your opponents, climb the ranks and earn rewards!

Play it now on:
Windows & Mac: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/spider-tanks-d3b6ae
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spider-tanks-cores-of-chaos/id6746262642
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nl.gamedia.spidertanks
